Dear Miss Yonge	
The [cheque](/topic/160) for £200 was sent you last night. My clerk reminded that former remittances were so made. The monthly payments will be sent the same way.
[I](/person/939)am going to have the second [chapter](/topic/177) as the first set up in type. I will venture to go over it and make any suggestions that strike me.

Yours ever faithfully
A. Macmillan
